batch_notes: Read all 60 complete input records in consecutive read_pilot.py chunks of 16000 characters from offset 0 to 279043, including every supplied part, row, footnote, transcription note and English layer. No input stream chunk was truncated.

A hunting-licence vocabulary gap is the only unresolved classification question. Source numerical discrepancies and unreadable cells were preserved as context and did not require classification review.

Recurring boundaries: multi-product production/trade summaries use aggregate labels; institutional participants remain under their subject; geography of publication does not establish imperial-rule or Indigenous subjects; measured distances, prices and room counts make mixed rosters statistical.

Some records have chapter/title/context descriptions narrower than or inconsistent with their body rows. Assignments follow the supplied complete rows (for example the casualty table under Railways and the chronology extending to 1930).
